title: Dynamic Invoice Adjustment API for Retroactive Usage Corrections and Corporate Audit Trails
creator: Lea Morgan
description: Objective: build a safe, auditable API and workflow that allows product, finance, and support to create retroactive invoice adjustments for enterprise customers when metering errors, late-reported usage, or contract credits must be applied. Support credits, pro-rated refunds, overage reversals, and produce immutable audit trails that satisfy SOC2 and customer security questionnaires.
background: Current pain: finance and support process mid-cycle credits and dispute refunds using manual spreadsheets and ticket attachments. This is slow (6–12 business days), error-prone, and creates poor auditability for enterprise contracts. Several channel partners and customers have requested an API and Console workflow that records approver identity, reason codes, and links to evidence for security questionnaires and contract audits.
proposal_summary: Ship a new Invoice Adjustment API (POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/adjustments) and a Console approval UI. Adjustments will create immutable ledger entries linked to original meter events and invoice lines. Three modes: credit (account credit ledger), refund (payment gateway reversal), and re-rate (recompute pro-rated invoice lines). Include idempotency keys, standardized reason codes, optional attachment references, and automatic audit log emission.
acceptance_criteria: API endpoint implemented with input validation, idempotency, and schema versioning
All adjustments create immutable audit rows surfaced in Console and exportable for customer audits
Support three adjustment types: credit, refund, re-rate with documented accounting flows
End-to-end integration with Stripe/Zuora sandbox for refunds; refunds fallback to queued manual process on gateway failure
Console UI to request, approve, and track adjustments for enterprise tenants behind RBAC
Telemetry: adjustment counts, mean time to resolution, disputes reopened, cost delta per adjustment
implementation_notes: Add adjustments table (immutable rows): adjustment_id, invoice_id, type, amount_minor, currency, reason_code, initiated_by, approved_by, created_at, processed_at, external_ref
Payment gateway interactions handled by payments worker with retries and dead-letter queue; capture gateway status on ledger
Include localized currency conversion and FX rounding rules; consult Finance FX policy document
Negative balances are capped to zero unless tenant has allow_negative_credit flag enabled by Finance
Proration uses tenant billing anchor and original usage intervals; re-rate generates delta invoice lines and a linked adjustment record
tradeoffs_and_risks: API-initiated refunds increase fraud/abuse risk; mitigation: strict RBAC, approvals, rate limits, and audit visibility
Retroactive re-rating can affect recognized revenue; require Finance sign-off for adjustments > $5k
Supporting full FX and multi-currency increases implementation time; MVP may restrict refunds to invoice currency
Audit retention increases storage and compliance costs; add compressed event store and configurable retention
rollout_plan: Week 1: finalize API schema and complete security review
Week 2–3: backend implementation, DB migration, payments worker integration
Week 4: Console UI, e2e tests, sandbox payment gateway integration
Week 5: internal dogfood with Finance and Support on pilot customers
Week 6: gated rollout to enterprise customers behind feature flag; monitor metrics and have revert plan
followups: Create Finance SOP for adjustment approval thresholds and logging
Update security questionnaire template with adjustment audit evidence fields
Train Support and CSM teams on new Console flow and SLAs
